objective: Test approved M08 V2 as a complete song with rhythmic repetition and spoken French breaks.

common.model_preference: v6-mini prototype; V6 full when accessible
common.style_prompt: raw dark acoustic guitar, strong rhythmic Spanish female sung refrain, intimate French female spoken breaks, organic percussion, restrained intense vocal, not cute or sugary

semantic_links.dar marcha atrás: The Spanish refrain refuses to reverse the decision; the French break asks whether she should reverse it.
semantic_links.echar en cara: The Spanish line reproaches her silence; the French line reproaches leaving the table.
semantic_links.hacer las paces: The Spanish line proposes reconciliation; the French line proposes making peace.
semantic_links.poner pegas: The Spanish line objects to her pain; the French line finds fault with what she says.

human_lyrics_approval.note: Vincent approved unchanged M08 V2 lyrics on 2026-11-10; approval remains valid until lyrics change.
